title: Meet the Democratic Congresswoman Donald Trump Is Trying to Imprison
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
When Donald Trump vowed to go after his political enemies if he returned to
the White House, he wasn't joking.

One of the people on his list of targets is none other than **LaMonica
McIver** , the New Jersey Democratic Congresswoman who has been [charged by
the Department of Justice](https://www.justice.gov/usao-nj/pr/congresswoman-
charged-forcibly-impeding-and-interfering-federal-officers) for allegedly
"assaulting, impeding, and interfering with law enforcement" during a routine
oversight visit to an ICE detention center in Newark, New Jersey last May,
that [devolved into all-out chaos](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-
news/newark-mayor-ras-baraka-arrested-ice-detention-facility-new-jersey-
rcna205949).

**" They tried to stop us from going in to have oversight,"** McIver tells
Mehdi.

She was never arrested on the day of the oversight visit, and is now the only
lawmaker facing charges - which could land her up to 17 years in prison. **"
If they [the Trump administration] can do what they can to me and other
members of Congress that we've seen happen, imagine what they're doing in the
dark,"** she says of the Trump administration.

Nevertheless, Rep. McIver continues to speak out against ICE's lawlessness:
**" I think a lot of people have to be prosecuted and held accountable,
including Kristi Noem and Pam Bondi... I think they've committed crimes and I
think that they have to be held responsible for those."**

In this wide-ranging interview, Rep. McIver also talks to Mehdi about:

  * The White House's smear campaign against her

  * Whether Democratic Party leadership is fit for this moment

  * The ongoing [DHS shutdown](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/dhs-funding-bill-senate-hurdles-killed-minneapolis-rcna255769)

  * Trump's war in Iran

  * The effort to censure Reps. Randy Fine and Andy Ogles over their [Islamophobic statements](https://www.axios.com/2026/03/13/censure-ogles-fine-muslims-democrats-republicans).
